audience.text: Go developers building server-side or cross-platform applications that require PDF processing, including document generation, form handling, digital signing, conversion to/from other formats, and accessibility compliance.

capabilities.text: Split, merge, extract, reorder, rotate, and delete pages; manage page labels, metadata (Info/XMP), and page geometry (MediaBox, CropBox, etc.).
capabilities.title: Page operations and metadata

capabilities.text: Apply password-based encryption (AES-128/AES-256/RC4) with granular permissions, sign documents with PKCS#7/PAdES signatures (RSA/ECDSA) with timestamps and LTV support, and use certificate-based encryption.
capabilities.title: Encryption and digital signatures

capabilities.text: Build documents top-to-bottom using the Flow layout engine for paragraphs, headings, images, tables, and lists with automatic pagination and multi-column support.
capabilities.title: Content authoring with Flow layout

capabilities.text: Create multi-page tables with repeating headers, cell merging, and styling; draw vector graphics (lines, rectangles, circles, paths, polygons) and use gradients and tiling patterns.
capabilities.title: Tables and vector graphics

capabilities.text: Create and manipulate form fields (text, checkbox, radio, combo, list, button, barcode, password, file select, rich text, number, date) with appearance generation and data interchange formats.
capabilities.title: AcroForms and interactive fields

capabilities.text: Convert PDF to/from Markdown, HTML, SVG, DOCX, XLSX, EPUB, and TIFF; validate and convert to PDF/A and PDF/UA; and export forms in FDF, XFDF, and JSON.
capabilities.title: Conversion and export

capabilities.text: Perform document summarization, OCR of scanned pages, document Q&A with conversation history, and automatic alt-text generation for figures using AI copilots over OpenAI-compatible endpoints.
capabilities.title: AI copilots for document intelligence

capabilities.text: Create and validate Tagged PDF for PDF/UA accessibility; validate structural integrity, PDF/A conformance, and PDF/UA prerequisites; and apply redactions with validation.
capabilities.title: Accessibility and validation

limitations.text: Linearization cannot be combined with encryption or digital signing in the same document.
Certificate-based encryption accepts RSA recipients only; elliptic curve recipients and legacy RC4 sub-filters are not written.
SearchText and ReplaceText match within a single text line only; queries that straddle line breaks are not found.
The built-in renderer does not support mesh shadings (PDF shading types 4-7); other shading types, patterns, and blend modes render normally.
ConvertToPDFA does not flatten transparency; call Document.FlattenTransparency() separately before converting to PDF/A-1.
MarkdownToDocument has no syntax highlighting; SaveMarkdown does not reconstruct tables from a PDF and caps inferred heading levels at 3.

problems_solved.text: Enables PDF document creation, merging, splitting, and page manipulation using a pure Go API without external native dependencies.
Supports building PDF content with a high-level Flow layout engine for paragraphs, headings, tables, lists, and images with automatic pagination.
Provides encryption (AES-128/AES-256/RC4), password protection, digital signatures (PKCS#7, PAdES, timestamps), and certificate-based encryption for document security.
Offers conversion to/from Markdown, HTML, SVG, DOCX, XLSX, EPUB, and TIFF, plus PDF/A and PDF/UA validation and conversion for archival and accessibility compliance.

product_summary.text: Aspose-PDF-FOSS-for-Go is a pure Go library for creating, editing, rendering, signing, encrypting, converting, and validating PDF documents without CGo, native libraries, or third-party dependencies.

workflows.name: Document creation and layout
workflows.text: Create a new document using NewDocument or NewDocumentFromFormat, use the Flow layout engine to add paragraphs, headings, tables, and lists, then render to pages and save.

workflows.name: Document editing and manipulation
workflows.text: Open an existing PDF using Open or OpenStream, perform operations like Split, Append, Rotate, Reorder, DeletePage, and AddBlankPage, then save the modified document.

workflows.name: Form handling and field population
workflows.text: Access the Form object, add or modify AcroForm fields (text, checkbox, radio, combo, list, button, barcode), set field values and styles, and export/import data in FDF, XFDF, or JSON formats.

workflows.name: Annotations, stamps, and redaction
workflows.text: Add annotations (highlight, underline, text, link, stamp, file attachment, redact) to pages, apply stamps (text, image, page number), and use redaction to permanently remove content.

workflows.name: Rendering and image extraction
workflows.text: Render pages to raster images (PNG, JPEG, GIF, BMP, TIFF) using Page.RenderImage or Document.RenderTIFF, or extract existing images from pages using Page.ExtractImages or Document.ExtractImages.

workflows.name: AI-powered document processing
workflows.text: Use AI copilots in the ai subpackage for summarization, OCR of scanned pages, document Q&A, and automatic alt-text generation, connecting to any OpenAI-compatible endpoint.
